name: Milkyway Intelligent Supply Chain Service Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Milkyway Chemical Supply Chain Service Co., Ltd., founded in 1997 and based in Shanghai, China, offers a wide array of chemical supply chain solutions on a global scale. Their comprehensive service portfolio includes managing import and export logistics, from cargo acquisition, booking, and consignment to secure warehousing, specialized packaging, efficient loading/unloading, and transit facilitation, culminating in effective distribution. They also handle regulatory filing and inspection processes, provide cargo insurance, and orchestrate international multimodal transport, alongside offering third-party (3PL) and tailored contract logistics services. Furthermore, Milkyway specializes in leasing and transporting various types of tank containers for both domestic and international trade, leveraging their own network of tank yards. They provide extensive technical support for container tanks, encompassing secure storage, thorough cleaning, heating, repair work, modifications, and general technical assistance. The company also expertly manages the transportation and associated logistical requirements for specialized LNG tank containers and dedicated chemical tankers. Milkyway's solutions cater to diverse critical industries, including oil and gas, petrochemicals, renewable energy, nuclear power, infrastructure development, engineering and construction, and mining and metallurgy, among others.
